name: shiro-screen-share
description: Shiro Screen Share — App desktop para capturar e transmitir tela para a atividade Discord
author: Hito

scripts.clean: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const fs = require('fs'); const target = 'dist'; if (process.platform === 'win32') { for (const proc of ['electron.exe', 'app-builder.exe']) { spawnSync('taskkill', ['/F', '/IM', proc, '/T'], { stdio: 'ignore' }); } } (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { try { if (fs.existsSync(target)) { fs.rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true }); } if (!fs.existsSync(target)) { console.log('cleaned dist'); return; } } catch (err) { if (err.code !== 'EBUSY' && err.code !== 'EPERM') { throw err; } } await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250 + i * 250)); } throw new Error('Could not remove dist folder. Close any Electron or file explorer windows using the build output and try again.'); })().catch((err) => { console.error(err.message); process.exit(1); });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder
scripts.build:release: npm run clean && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.pack: npm run clean && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
